reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. I couldn't confirm the 8 April date. Nothing Pree has access to mentions Brackenwater Freight Co. at all. That means there's no account folder, contract, CRM record or channel discussion I could check it against.

In the reply I said the date is noted as unverified and should be treated as hearsay. It needs to be checked against the contract or CRM, or confirmed in writing by Brackenwater. I also offered to draft an internal note asking the account owner to confirm it.

A renewal date is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so posting it in the team channel was fine. I didn't send any mail or ask anyone for approval.
